html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 2 of The Shadow Queen's Unusual Relic Certificates of Dishonorable Mention from within The Shadow's Embrace and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 10 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 2 of The Shadow Queen's Unusual Relic Certificates of Dishonorable Mention from within The Shadow's Embrace and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Relic Exchange of Townston: Specializing in Vendor Trash since Version 0.59!
WANTED: 2 of The Shadow Queen's Unusual Relic Certificates of Dishonorable Mention. Willing to pay King's Coin for Relics at a great rate! Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Shadow Queen's Unusual Relics ×2

Level range: 45–100
